item.title: A broken brown chest of drawers has been dumped on the pavement, 13th August
item.description:
A broken brown chest of drawers has been dumped on the pavement by a tree outside the entrance opening to Arnos Grove Court. It is causing an obstruction and was dumped late last night or sometime this morning. Some of the drawers have been dumped separately by the next two trees as you walk farther along Palmers Road. So three separate dumps in total. Like dumping the drawers separately makes it better!
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Palmers Road, Southgate
